diagnostic_evidence.quote: on the event $\{\tau=\infty\}$, the iterates exhibit conditional geometric convergence in expectation

issues.failure_explanation: The event {tau=infinity} is not F_k-measurable. An inequality for E[·|F_k] cannot be restricted to it to obtain E[·|F_k,{tau=infinity}], and if P({tau=infinity})=0 the conditional expectation is undefined. The proof also only yields an upper bound, not the stated two-sided limit to C.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must either provide a valid survival-conditioning argument or weaken the conclusion to an unconditional or finite-horizon bound and assume positive survival probability.
issues.overall_effect: The fixed-rate local conditional convergence guarantee is unsupported; the advertised late-stage local rate conditional on basin survival is unreliable.
issues.title: Conditional local rate on infinite survival is obtained by invalid restriction to a future event
issues.why_classification: This is a central local nonconvex guarantee; fixing it requires new proof architecture or changes the type of guarantee.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Moreover, the exit time $\tau$ satisfies the basin-stability bound

issues.failure_explanation: The displayed implication from eq:cond-step to E[Y_{k+1}|F_k] ≤ (1-ρ1_{k<τ})Y_k does not make Y_{k∧τ} a supermartingale. When Y_k<0, (1-ρ)Y_k can be larger than Y_k, and the relaxed noise term after stopping also breaks the claimed inequality. For example, starting at a minimizer gives Y_1=-C<0 while nonzero noise can cause exit with positive probability, contradicting the stated bound P(τ=∞)≥1.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must derive a correct exit bound accounting for the noise floor C or restrict the theorem to a regime where the supermartingale argument is valid, losing the advertised below-floor stability guarantee.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit lower bound on the probability of remaining in the basin is false or unsupported.
issues.title: Local basin-stability bound follows from a false supermartingale claim
issues.why_classification: This is a central advertised stability guarantee and the stated bound does not survive a simple correction.
